title: Reading Drill — Studying the Use of a Covered Bridge
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Studying the Use of a Covered Bridge
passages.body:
**A** Students counted people crossing a bridge on wet and dry days. They distinguished people passing through from those who stayed under the cover to wait for the rain to clear.

**B** The bridge became crowded in sudden showers despite carrying little traffic on some rainy days. The length of the queue depended partly on how quickly the rain had begun.

**C** The students suggested drawing two walking lanes through the shelter. They planned to see whether the markings would change where waiting people stand.

questions.prompt: They distinguished people passing through from those who stayed under the ______ to wait for the rain to clear.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: They distinguished people passing through from those who stayed under the cover to wait for the rain to clear.

questions.prompt: The length of the queue depended partly on how quickly the ______ had begun.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The length of the queue depended partly on how quickly the rain had begun.

questions.prompt: They planned to see whether the markings would change where waiting people ______.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: They planned to see whether the markings would change where waiting people stand.

questions.prompt: Queue length was influenced by how suddenly rain began.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The bridge became crowded in sudden showers despite carrying little traffic on some rainy days. The length of the queue depended partly on how quickly the rain had begun.
